QC-GBL-003 — Accessibility
Tools
FRONTEND — Visitor Accessibility Controls
User Story ID
QC-GBL-003 | US001 | REF:
FR-001, FR-003
Title
Accessibility Tools — Visitor Controls
As a
public website visitor (including visitors with
disabilities)
I want
to use the accessibility tools in the website header to
adjust contrast, zoom in/out, and apply other accessibility features
So that
I can access and read the Qatar Chamber website content
comfortably according to my accessibility needs
Preconditions:
- The Qatar Chamber website is published and accessible.
- Accessibility tools are enabled in the CMS header
configuration.
Frontend Workflow:
1. Visitor loads any page of the Qatar Chamber website.
2. Visitor sees the accessibility tools icon in the site
header .
3. Visitor clicks the accessibility icon — an accessibility
panel opens with controls: High Contrast toggle, Zoom In (+), Zoom Out (-),
Reset / Normal View.
4. Visitor clicks High Contrast — the site switches to a
high-contrast color theme in real time.
5. Visitor clicks Zoom In — all page text increases in size
by one increment without a page reload.
6. Visitor clicks Zoom Out — all page text decreases in size
by one increment without a page reload.
7. Visitor clicks Reset / Normal View — font size and
contrast revert to the default settings.
8. All changes apply in real time without a page reload.
9. Accessibility settings persist throughout the visitor's
browser session.
Given the
visitor is on any page of the website
When the
visitor uses the accessibility tools
Then
- The system shall display the accessibility tools icon
in the site header.
- Clicking the accessibility icon shall open a panel
with: high contrast toggle, zoom in, zoom out, and reset / normal view
controls.
- Activating high contrast shall apply a high-contrast
color theme (dark background, high-contrast text) to the entire site in real
time.
- Clicking zoom in / zoom out shall increase or decrease
the base font size across the site by one increment per click.
- Clicking reset / normal view shall restore the default
font size and contrast.
- All accessibility changes shall apply without a full
page reload.
- Accessibility settings shall persist for the duration
of the visitor's browser session.
- The website shall comply with WCAG 2.1 level aa
standards: sufficient color contrast ratios, keyboard navigability, and descriptive
alt text on all images.
- All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs)
shall be keyboard-navigable and focusable via the tab key.
Edge Case Scenarios:
- If the visitor's browser does not support CSS variable
overrides, High Contrast mode shall gracefully fall back to the default theme
without errors.
Negative Scenarios:
- If the accessibility panel fails to open, the visitor
shall see no broken UI — the icon shall remain visible but the panel shall not
open.
Post Condition:
- Accessibility tools are active and the visitor has
adjusted their preferred contrast and font size for the session. The site meets
WCAG 2.1 Level AA standards.
BACKEND — Admin CMS Management
User Story ID
QC-GBL-003 | US002 | REF:
FR-001, FR-003
Title
Accessibility Tools — CMS Configuration
As a
authorized admin user (Site Content Editor)
I want
to enable or disable the accessibility tools widget in the
site header, and ensure all images have bilingual alt text in Liferay CMS
So that
accessibility features are available to all visitors
Preconditions:
- Admin user has the appropriate role in Liferay CMS.
- The header management module is accessible in the CMS.
Administrator Workflow:
1. Site Content Editor logs into Liferay CMS.
2. Navigates to Global Components → Header Management →
Accessibility Settings.
3. Toggles Accessibility Tools Enabled ON or OFF.
4. Saves and publishes the configuration.
5. System saves and displays a Liferay generic success toast
message.
6. For all image uploads across the CMS, the admin enters
bilingual alt text (EN + AR) to ensure accessibility compliance.
7. System validates that alt text is provided for all images
before publishing content.
8. Published configuration reflects on the frontend after the
standard cache refresh.
Given the admin
opens Accessibility Settings in the CMS
When the admin configures
the accessibility tools and alt text
Then
- The system shall allow the admin to enable or disable
the accessibility tools widget via the global header configuration.
- When accessibility tools are disabled, the
accessibility icon shall not appear in the frontend header.
- The system shall require bilingual alt text (EN + AR)
for all image uploads before allowing publish.
- If alt text is missing at publish time: "alt text
is required before publishing." النص البديل مطلوب قبل النشر.
- The system shall display a Liferay generic success
toast message after each successful CMS action.
Negative Scenarios:
- If the admin lacks the required permission:
"Access Denied. You do not have permission to perform this action." تم
رفض الوصول. ليس لديك صلاحية لتنفيذ هذا الإجراء.
- If alt text is missing for an image at publish:
"Alt text (AR) is required before publishing." النص البديل (عربي) مطلوب
قبل النشر.
Post Condition:
- Accessibility tools are active on the frontend. All
images have bilingual alt text. The site meets WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility
standards.
